General Dentistry

General Dentistry for Kansas City, MO Patients

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport is here for all your oral health needs. We provide a general dentist in Kansas City, MO that serves individuals, families, and patients of all ages. Our general dental care includes exams, bi-annual cleanings, and screenings to ensure the mouth, teeth, and gums are in optimal condition. From assessing your smile's shape and health to recommending treatments, you can trust us to guide you and help you make the right decisions regarding your teeth. We provide preventative services in a kind, compassionate dental office. You'll feel comfortable and confident as we make your smile the best it can be.
Contact Us

General Dental Exams and Cleanings

Our services will keep your teeth and mouth in pristine condition. We provide the following services routinely for our patients:

  • Bi-Annual Exams: We schedule ADA-recommended bi-annual exams of our patients' mouths, teeth, and gums. We'll carefully assess your oral health and determine its condition.
  • Teeth Cleaning: During your bi-annual exam, we will use advanced cleaning technology and methods to clean and sanitize your mouth, freeing it from plaque and tartar.
  • Cancer Screenings: Getting your mouth screened for cancer is crucial. We thoroughly evaluate our patients' mouths for cancer signs and refer them to specialists who can provide further treatment.

Personalized Dental Treatments Fit for You

Hopefully, you maintain a good oral health regimen at home that includes regular brushing, flossing, and mouthwashing. While these activities are essential to oral health, more advanced care is required in certain instances. Our dentists can assess, diagnose, and treat conditions you cannot do at home, such as oral disease and tooth decay. We provide comprehensive examinations of the mouth using cutting-edge X-rays and screenings. Whether you want to fix a significant health issue like decay or a cosmetic flaw like discoloration, you can depend on Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport's innovative technology and skilled team to fulfill your needs.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
